cases.title: three-app task keeps a complete trace and replayable audit
preconditions: three Apps participate: orchestrator, calendar, and notes
the task crosses at least two delegation or handoff boundaries
steps: run the end-to-end task across the three Apps
inspect trace_id and causation_id on every message
export the audit chain by trace_id
verify chain integrity and replay the trace without executing side effects

expect.notes: Every hop MUST share one trace_id, each hop MUST carry causation_id, and the export MUST be both verifiable and free of plaintext secrets (§10.6).

cases.title: tampered audit chain fails verification
cases.notes: The second event no longer links to the first hash. AUDIT_CHAIN_INVALID is an extension domain code: the spec requires verification to fail but defines no audit error code.

cases.title: user audit export is redacted while remaining verifiable
cases.notes: Redaction MAY replace sensitive fields with a per-export salted commitment; integrity MUST remain verifiable (§10.6).

cases.title: cross-user request is denied by default
cases.notes: Each user session has its own Bus; cross-user traffic MUST be explicitly enabled and consented to by both sides (§11.2).

cases.title: replay does not repeat side effects
cases.notes: Replay MUST be permission-bound and MUST NOT re-execute side effects (§10.6).

cases.title: L3 effect with only an intent is marked unknown and alerted
cases.notes: examples/audit-chain.json ends at effect.intent with no effect.executed; recovery MUST mark the effect unknown and require reconciliation (§8.11, §10.5).

cases.title: 0.1 does not claim protection against a compromised Bus

expect.notes: 0.1 trusts the Bus (P0); claiming protection against a compromised Bus is non-conforming. P1 evaluates hardened transports separately (§3.6, §11.1).
